description: This course provides hands-on experience in implementing machine learning algorithms using Python and scikit-learn. Topics include supervised learning techniques such as linear regression, decision trees, and support vector machines; unsupervised learning methods like k-means clustering and principal component analysis; and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. Students will implement and evaluate models using real-world datasets, focusing on data preprocessing, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and performance metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The course also covers ethical considerations in AI and the use of standard ML libraries for data analysis and visualization.

clos.text: Define key concepts in machine learning such as supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning
Describe the architecture and workflow of deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch
Explain the mathematical foundations of linear regression and logistic regression models
Apply data preprocessing techniques including normalization, feature scaling, and one-hot encoding
Implement machine learning algorithms such as k-means clustering and support vector machines using scikit-learn

Build decision tree and random forest models
Apply k-means clustering to a dataset
Construct a simple neural network using TensorFlow
Build RNN for time series prediction
Develop a neural network using PyTorch
Optimize model parameters using grid search
